title: Raghav Juyal Breaks Silence on Viral Video of Shielding Shehnaaz Gill From Paparazzi Mob
excerpt: The actor-dancer said his instinct to protect came from the values his parents instilled in him, dismissing relationship speculation with the actress.
body:
• Raghav Juyal addressed a viral video from his birthday celebration showing him shielding Shehnaaz Gill from a crowd of fans and paparazzi
  • The actor said his protective instinct was rooted in his upbringing: "My parents raised me to be a man"
  • Shehnaaz Gill separately described Raghav as a close friend and urged fans to support his upcoming film Bhai Tera Star Hai
  • The incident reignited dating rumours that have circulated since the pair appeared together in Salman Khan's Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan

A video clip from Raghav Juyal's recent birthday celebration went viral over the weekend, showing the actor-dancer physically shielding Shehnaaz Gill as she navigated through an aggressive crowd of fans and paparazzi. The footage reignited dating speculation that has followed the pair since they appeared together in Salman Khan's 2023 film Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan.

"I Will Protect Till My Death"

Speaking to Pinkvilla, Raghav said his reaction was instinctive and rooted in the values his parents taught him. "My parents raised me to be a man. If you had been there with me, or any woman, and a group of men had pounced on her, I was brought up to throw a solid punch if needed," he said. "I will protect till my death — my friends, my family, and any woman I'm with."

The actor pushed back against the idea that celebrities should maintain a detached public persona during such situations. "I can't just watch if a woman is being harassed, no matter who she is. In those moments, I don't think about my star image or any public image," he added.

"If there's such a thing as sacred feminine energy, there's also sacred masculinity. Both need to exist in balance."

— Raghav Juyal

Shehnaaz Gill Sidesteps Rumours

Shehnaaz addressed the dating speculation separately in a conversation with Pinkvilla, choosing not to comment on her personal life. "No personal questions, please," she said, before pivoting to promote Raghav's work. "My friend's film is coming — Bhai Tera Star Hai. Please support him. He is my very good friend. It is important for his film to work."

What's Next

Raghav Juyal is gearing up for the release of Bhai Tera Star Hai, while Shehnaaz continues to build her acting career following her debut in Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan. The viral moment has drawn fresh attention to both stars and is likely to keep the rumour mill churning until they address it more directly.
